execution_boundary.allowed_algorithm: mirror fields and branch order only; relation predicates may be invoked synchronously on application-main only after their existing read-only call boundary is retained
execution_boundary.live_boundary: pre-contact and post-contact read paths are production-wired, but actual_contact_scope_ready remains false until paused fixtures compare predictions with native join/create transitions and the resulting CombatID/side arrays

shape.full_id_rule: mask only the low 24-bit slot index, then require the complete generation-bearing ID to match the resolved object

CProvince.+0x08: map node; adjacency data +0x50, signed count +0x5C, row stride 0x30
CProvince.+0x20_then_+0x1B: raw target contact-admission byte; business name not closed
CProvince.+0x740: full landed TitleID fallback for holder projection
CProvince.+0x744: full holder CharacterID; -1 enters title fallback
CProvince.+0x748/+0x754: full CUnitID data/count scanned for seed and opponents
CProvince.+0x760/+0x76C: full CCombatID data/count scanned for join candidates

CUnit.+0x18: raw contact-state int32; resolver requires zero

CArmy.+0x128: full CCombatID; valid resolve means already in combat

CCombat.+0x704: finalized byte used by contact candidate scan

CCombatSide.+0x70: primary participant full CharacterID; absolute CCombat offsets +0x90 attacker and +0x3D8 defender
CCombatSide.public_id_mapping: resolve each internal CArmyID, require CArmy+0x124 full CUnitID to resolve and backlink to that CArmy, then publish the CUnitID as public army_id
CCombatSide.insert_semantics: 0x23C9100 checks the existing side ArmyID array and tail-appends through 0xA886F0 only when the full CArmyID is absent

BattleResult.+0x28: ready byte required before loser-side exclusion is collected

cunit_manager_order.iteration: freeze end at entry, generation-resolve each ID, then call 0x2247C50(CUnit*) serially in stored order
cunit_manager_order.post_loop: tail-call 0x27C0E90 only after all movement updates

normal_movement_enqueue.flag_name_boundary: the first flag byte is only proven to suppress contact enqueue when nonzero; call it normal_movement_enqueue_suppressed_raw, not a broader gameplay name

province_unit_order.rule: after rejecting an existing equal ID, insert the full CUnitID at its unsigned-32-bit lower-bound-equivalent position
province_unit_order.daily_consequence: the post-movement Province array consumed by contact scans is unsigned full-CUnitID order for normal movement additions, not arrival append order

contact_queue.manager_root: *(module+0x570E068), then +0xA0 game-data pointer, then +0x25580 embedded manager
contact_queue.producer_gate: normal_movement_enqueue_suppressed_raw == 0, CUnit+0x18 == 0, and CUnit+0x178 resolves to an identity-matching CArmy
contact_queue.order: pure tail append with no sort and no dedupe; append execution order inherits the serial CUnitManager traversal, with any multiple commits by one CUnit remaining in that CUnit's execution order

consumer.order: scan queue +0x98 to frozen end in append order
consumer.per_entry: resolve CArmyID, skip a generation-valid existing CCombat, resolve CArmy+0x124 to CUnit and its current CUnit+0x20 Province, then call 0x2208320(Province*,CUnit*)
consumer.same_day_tie: normal daily arrival initiator order is the CUnitManager stored traversal order, while each target Province opponent order is the post-movement unsigned full-CUnitID order

entry_gates: target CProvince+0x20 pointer raw byte +0x1B is nonzero
inline mirror of 0x290CFF0(incoming,true): CUnit+0x18==0, retreat<=0, linked CArmy is not empty-without-gathering and has no valid combat
incoming CUnit+0x174 owner CharacterID resolves and passes its identity predicate

army_empty_predicate.true_when: sum of current_soldiers from generation-valid CArmy+0x38 regiments is <= 0 and CArmy+0x5C gathering_count is zero

army_in_combat_predicate.true_when: CArmy+0x128 resolves to a full-ID-matching CCombat whose identity predicate is true

existing_combat_selection.order: unsigned full-CCombatID ascending because creation inserts through 0x22099AD..0x2209A0D
existing_combat_selection.compatibility: for each non-finalized combat, call 0x2900470(incoming_owner, attacker_primary,0) and 0x2900470(incoming_owner, defender_primary,0); compatible iff exactly one result is true
existing_combat_selection.selection: overwrite the saved candidate for every compatible row; therefore the final result is the last compatible CCombat in unsigned full-CCombatID ascending order, not the first

predicted_join_side.rule: 0x2900470(attacker_primary,incoming_owner,0) true predicts defender side; otherwise 0x2900470(defender_primary,incoming_owner,0) true predicts attacker side
predicted_join_side.strict_query_gate: require exactly one reverse-direction relation before publishing a side; relation asymmetry is unavailable rather than guessed
predicted_join_side.post_transition_arrays: strictly map both current CCombatSide arrays, then tail-append the incoming internal CArmyID to the predicted side using 0x23C9100 first-seen semantics

loser_exclusion.gate: only while no compatible combat has yet been saved; require valid BattleResultID, BattleResult+0x28 nonzero, and winner index != -1
loser_exclusion.payload: append the losing CCombatSide's CArmyID array in its stored order to a temporary exclusion vector
loser_exclusion.winner_mapping: winner 0 attacker -> copy defender +0x368; winner nonzero -> copy attacker +0x20
loser_exclusion.impact_boundary: used only by the first-hostile seed scan; it does not alter existing-combat selection and is not passed into 0x2209450, so it does not directly filter the final opponent vector

new_combat_selection.source: target CProvince+0x748/+0x754 full CUnitID array in unsigned order
new_combat_selection.seed_rule: choose the first candidate that passes every gate
candidate_gates: candidate owner full CharacterID differs from incoming owner
CUnit+0x178 resolves to an identity-matching CArmy
CArmyID is absent from the temporary loser-exclusion vector
new_combat_selection.initiator_strength_gate: sum current_soldiers over generation-valid initiating CArmy regiments must be positive
new_combat_selection.no_seed_result: no contact transition; native resolver may take a non-contact fallback, which the read-only query does not emulate

opponent_builder.abi: void build_and_create_contact(CProvince* target, CArmy* initiating, int32 defender_seed_owner_id)
opponent_builder.source: target CProvince+0x748/+0x754 full CUnitID unsigned order
candidate_gates: candidate owner equals defender_seed_owner_id, or 0x2900470(candidate_owner,initiating_owner,0) is true
opponent_builder.order_and_membership: append every passing CArmy* to the temporary opponent vector in Province unsigned full-CUnitID order; the vector has no sort, no dedupe, and no loser-exclusion check
opponent_builder.final_side_boundary: 0x2303CF0 feeds the temporary vector through 0x23C9100, so final CCombatSide ArmyID arrays retain only the first occurrence of each full CArmyID while preserving vector order
opponent_builder.forbidden_boundary: 0x2209450 is not callable by a read-only query because it continues to 0x27FB7C0

side_orientation.fort_branch: if CProvince+0x858 > 0, derive the holder from +0x744 or the +0x740 landed-title fallback and test 0x2900710(initiating_owner,holder)
side_orientation.fallback_branch: if the fort/holder relation did not classify the initiator, test 0x290CD60(initiating_owner,target)

polarity_proof.true: initiating CArmy -> defender side1; opponents -> attacker side0
polarity_proof.false: initiating CArmy -> attacker side0; opponents -> defender side1
polarity_proof.correction: the boolean must not be named initiator_is_attacker
polarity_proof.predicted_arrays_true: attacker = first-seen opponent CArmyIDs; defender = [initiating CArmyID]
polarity_proof.predicted_arrays_false: attacker = [initiating CArmyID]; defender = first-seen opponent CArmyIDs

adjacency_kind.source: initiating CArmy+0x124 -> CUnit; origin +0x20, target +0x30; scan origin map-node adjacency rows
adjacency_kind.default: raw kind zero when the validated edge is absent

writes: write the new full CCombatID to initiating and opponent CArmy+0x128

province_combat_insert.rule: unsigned-32-bit lower-bound insert of the new full CCombatID into CProvince+0x760
province_combat_insert.same_batch_effect: later queue entries on the same daily pass observe the newly created combat in the sorted active-combat array

combat_end_rescan.rule: remove ended CombatID from CProvince+0x760, refresh Province state, then call 0x220D2A0(CProvince*)
combat_end_rescan.rescan_order: freeze Province+0x754 count and process CUnitIDs by index while reloading +0x748; call 0x2208320 for eligible non-combat units

post_contact_observation.entry: when exact 0x22771F0 reports that the subject CArmy has a generation-valid active CCombat
algorithm: read the positive full CCombatID from subject CArmy+0x128 and strict-resolve CCombat storage +0x08
require CCombat+0x704 finalized byte zero for the just-created/joined contact outcome
strict-resolve CCombat+0x6B8 Province and require actual ProvinceID, requested target and subject CUnit+0x20 current Province to be identical
read the Province +0x748 CUnitID and +0x760 CCombatID tables in their native numeric order and locate subject and CombatID
read attacker CCombat+0x20 and defender CCombat+0x368 ArmyID arrays without sorting
for every side CArmyID require CArmy+0x128 to link this same CombatID, map CArmy+0x124 to a full public CUnitID, and require the CUnit+0x178 backlink
require nonempty disjoint sides and require the subject public CUnitID to occur in exactly one side
repeat the entire observation and publish only when both samples and the outer paused snapshot revision match

result.attacker_army_ids: ordered public CUnitIDs mapped from CCombat attacker side
result.defender_army_ids: ordered public CUnitIDs mapped from CCombat defender side

post_contact_observation.reconciliation: pre-contact predicted attacker/defender public CUnitID arrays must equal post-contact actual arrays by value and order; set equality or a command ACK is insufficient

minimum_read_only_query.name: query_actual_contact_scope_v1
minimum_read_only_query.input: public full CUnitID and expected current/target ProvinceID
algorithm: strictly resolve CUnit, linked CArmy, owner Character and current Province; mirror all entry gates

if CArmy+0x128 resolves through 0x22771F0, read and validate the actual CCombat Province and ordered public attacker/defender CUnitID arrays, then return in_combat without invoking relation or mutation helpers

scan every Province CombatID in stored unsigned full-ID order and retain the last forward-direction relation-XOR-compatible combat while collecting only the native loser exclusions allowed before the first saved candidate

if a combat was retained, mirror the reverse-direction join-side checks, strictly map both current side arrays, append incoming to the predicted side with 0x23C9100 first-seen semantics, and return join_existing without calling 0x23040A0
otherwise choose the first eligible hostile seed in Province unsigned full-CUnitID order, applying loser exclusions only here
rescan the complete Province CUnit array with 0x2209450's filters and directed relation order to build the ordered opponent ArmyID vector
mirror holder/fallback side classification and adjacency kind, project final side arrays with 0x23C9100 first-seen semantics, then return create_new without calling 0x2209450 or 0x27FB7C0
repeat the entire read and publish only when both complete samples match

result.incoming: public CUnitID, internal CArmyID, owner CharacterID
result.scheduler_provenance: optional CUnitManager stored index and projected queue index
result.in_combat: positive existing CCombatID, actual target ProvinceID, Combat array index, and actual ordered attacker/defender public CUnitID arrays
result.join_existing: full CCombatID, saved combat-array index, predicted side, current and predicted attacker/defender public/internal ArmyID arrays
result.create_new: defender seed CharacterID, ordered public/internal raw opponent vector, predicted attacker/defender public/internal ArmyID arrays, initiator_is_defender, initiator side, opponent side, raw adjacency kind
result.evidence: array counts, relation booleans in their exact call directions, exclusion IDs, and two-sample equality

fail_closed: reverse-direction join relation is not exactly one

remaining_live_matrix: separate later arrival joins an existing combat
multiple relation-compatible combats preserve the last-compatible selection
